# Inchwright

> Inchwright is a physics puzzle game for iPhone, coming soon to the App Store. Inch the inchworm has to reach the Old Oak before summer ends. The player builds him a tiny cart from meadow things and rebuilds it at every stopover along the trail.

- Each level is a trail of one to three legs (grassy slopes, puddles, wind, gaps, tall steps). At the end of each leg is a Stopover, where the run halts and the player takes the cart apart and rebuilds it. Only parts fixed on the cart come along to the next stopover.
- Parts: Twig, Reed, Acorn Wheel, Tendril (a coiled spring that drives the wheels), Seed Pod (floats), Leaf Sail, Silk Spinner (a silk line that reels the cart across gaps), Hopper Leg (jumps).
- 48 levels on four trails: Clover Bank (free), Brookside, Bramble Gap, Windmill Rise. Each level has three stars: reach the Oak, pick up every dewdrop, and Light load (few parts used).
- One help, Sketch, draws a working cart for the current stopover.
- Two one-time in-app purchases: Every Trail (opens the last three trails) and Field Notebook (unlimited Sketches). No ads, no analytics, no tracking, no account, no timers, no energy.
- Portrait, played with one hand. English.
